invariants: Each entry skill owns its detailed state machine, permissions, failures, and recovery.
The router never patches host skills and never carries a plugin installation path.
common.stateBoundary: Workflow state stays local under `.grill-adapter/context/`; do not commit it or bypass an entry skill's documented workflow when changing it. `.grill-adapter/settings.json` is project configuration.

activation: This router is inert unless the matching grill stage is explicitly invoked.
Do not infer a stage from an ordinary request.
When no matching stage is active, do not route adapter work.
During a matching active stage, invoke every listed entry skill at its row's stated workflow moment; the route is mandatory, not advisory. Do not invoke a later-moment route early.
An explicit adapter-skill invocation remains available outside a grill stage.

routes.purpose: Verify source-of-truth policy for the spec.
Carry selected context and verify the plan.
Establish one task before code changes.

crossStage.moment: Any stage with a durable candidate
crossStage.purpose: Record it for post-review Capture instead of writing Wiki state directly.
Run an audit or consolidation only when explicitly requested.

grill.rosterBoundary: For local scratch tickets use the NN filename prefix; for a real tracker use its issue number. Preserve verbatim ticket text.

activation: Plain workflows do not infer a host stage.
When an explicit workflow moment matches a row, invoke every listed entry skill at that moment; the route is mandatory, not advisory.
